visual_review: Lucide thumbs-up construction at ~1.8x on SQUARE: cuff box split by a cuff line, thumb edge tangent into an r5 tip (3-4-5 point), fist front slanting down to a rounded base. Reads as thumbs up at 48, both themes.
omissions: Reference's small finger scallops on the fist front are simplified to one smooth slanted edge (Lucide style).
